notes: New: AmbientSounds (Mods > Converted, on). Birds in forests and plains, crickets and owls at night, wind up high and in the open, waves at the beach, rain on the leaves, drips and rumbles in caves, the nether's moan - fading in and out with where you are, the time and the weather. Each sound downloads the first time it plays.
New: Sound Physics (on). Sounds behind walls are muffled (more through wool, less through glass), caves and big rooms echo, far sounds soften, and everything is muffled under water.
Also in this update: much faster on Chromebooks (the flashlight's shader no longer runs when no flashlight is on), Render Resolution in Video Settings, and a smaller download.
